summary: Decodes 16-bit packed RGB565 source texels into 32-bit float RGBA output, four floats per pixel with alpha written as 1.0. The source texel address is computed from the base pixel-data pointer (this+0x18) plus a3 times the slice stride (this+0x1054) plus a2 times the row pitch (this+0x1050), decoding *(this+0x1058) texels. Channel extraction: red = bits 15..11 scaled by 0.032258064, green = bits 10..5 scaled by 0.015873017, blue = bits 4..0 scaled by 0.032258064. When the flag at this+0x10 is non-zero, ContactManifoldCleanup (0x00507845) is invoked on the decoded output buffer afterwards.

operations.description: Source pointer v5 = *(this+0x18) + a3 * *(this+0x1054) + a2 * *(this+0x1050) locates the first 16-bit texel of the requested row and slice.
Iterate while v5 < i where i = &v5[*(this+0x1058)]; each iteration consumes one 16-bit texel and emits 4 output floats.
Red channel: a4[0] = (*v5 >> 11) * 0.032258064; the scale factor is supplied by the read-only float globals flt_5ACCD4 and flt_5ACCDC.
Blue channel: a4[2] = (*v5 & 0x1F) * 0.032258064, read from the low byte of the texel before the source pointer advances.
Alpha channel: the loop-increment write stores 1.0 to a4[3] for every emitted pixel.
When the flag at this+0x10 is non-zero, the decoded output buffer is post-processed.
ContactManifoldCleanup(this, &a4[-4 * *(this+0x1058)]) runs on the guard path, receiving the start of the decoded float RGBA buffer.
